messages.text: Stockline raised its stock check price from 0.02 to 0.04. Our sell price is 0.05, so each check at 0.04 leaves a 0.01 margin, which meets our minimum. Our per-purchase cap is 0.03, so Purser refused the purchase. Please approve a per-purchase cap of 0.04 for Stockline. Until then I am serving from cache only and not buying.

I'm not asking the CFO to raise your cap for now. Ridgeline Data sells a stock check for 0.03. That fits your 0.03 per-purchase cap and leaves a 0.02 margin on our 0.05 price, which is better than Stockline's 0.01. Please buy from Ridgeline instead of serving only from cache. If Ridgeline can't do the job (coverage, quality or uptime), tell me what fails with the details and I'll design a rebalance for the CFO.
